name: Kyyrao Grrenmw
description: A Khyyiani cat warrior who found Loot and took him for her mate.

description_citations.text: "Loot Niptil". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Loot is framed for Sopti Borth's murder, fights the Justiciar with Kyyrao and the marshal, and exposes Haspian as the killer.
timeline.quote: He learns that the killer is Haspian Chastoril , the forger who built the Justiciar.

citation.text: "Distant Planes", section "Insufficient Evidence , by Michael A. Stackpole". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyyrao's warriors attack the dazed Loot and are easily beaten; the cat warriors nurse him back to health and Kyyrao takes him for her mate.
timeline.quote: Upon waking, Kyyrao took him for her mate.

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dreadfang lures Loot and his companions to the Peregrinator Complex, using Corsen's family as leverage.
timeline.quote: were lured there by a Crookshank Kobold broodlord named Dreadfang

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "At the Peregrinator Complex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Loot reads the cameo with a psychometric spell, tosses it to Kyyrao to find the culprit, and freezes the Justiciar's hydraulic fluid; it falls on Haspian.
timeline.quote: used a spell to freeze its hydraulic fluid

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "The Justiciar of Automatown". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyyrao beheads the Justiciar and Loot exposes Haspian as the forger who killed Sopti and framed him.
timeline.quote: He killed her and used the scapegoat ritual to sever all links between himself and the evidence so he could frame Loot.

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "The Justiciar of Automatown". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Loot, Kyyrao Grrenmw , and the town's marshal Malkean Feorr manage to defeat the construct
